profile_text.body:
IBM, founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, is a publicly traded enterprise technology company (NYSE: IBM) that reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The company's website focuses on IBM OpenPages, which it describes as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises. OpenPages offers modular components covering risk management, compliance, audit, and model governance, and includes an interactive workspace called the OpenPages GRC Canvas for modeling processes, risks, and controls with live data. The site also notes an OpenPages MCP Server intended to allow AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed automation frameworks.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, which incorporates AI-specific modules for risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and automated documentation, and IBM watsonx.governance, which covers AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, including accelerators for the EU AI Act. IBM watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. The broader IBM watsonx platform is described as a model-agnostic enterprise AI platform that incorporates agent inventory management, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site additionally notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and that Citi partnered with IBM to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning.

The held facts show IBM carries significant legal exposure in New York, with 299 associated cases recorded there, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data. IBM holds a verified SEC filing presence under CIK 0000051143, consistent with its status as a public company reporting on Form 10-K.
